test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is **"Exggibitionistic"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's look at the correct word: __ • **Exhibitionist **which means** **a person who behaves in ways intended to attract attention or display their powers, personality, etc. (एक व्यक्ति जो ध्यान आकर्षित करने या अपनी शक्तियों, व्यक्तित्व आदि को प्रदर्शित करने के इरादे से व्यवहार करता है) • ***Eg.*** I have an *exhibitionist* streak that comes out on the dance floor. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the meaning of the other words: • **Meritorious - **deserving great praise (बड़ी प्रशंसा के पात्र) • ***Eg.*** An award for *meritorious *service • **Traumatic -** severe and lasting emotional shock and pain caused by an extremely upsetting experience, or a case of such shock happening. (गंभीर और स्थायी भावनात्मक आघात और दर्द) • ***Eg. ***He had psychotherapy to help him deal with his childhood *traumas*. • **Stigmatic -** relating to a stigma or stigmas, in particular constituting or conveying a mark of disgrace (विशेष रूप से अपमान का संदेश देना) • ***Eg. ***The less* stigmatic *offence of manslaughter. 3c:T9c6, The correct answer is** "Lose one’s temper"**
